claim_limits: Qualification screen on three fixed historical small multimodal models, not an LLM-scale benchmark.
Four update schedules measure within-model training variation; they are not four independent models.
Fourteen retained calibration values supplement the readout. No claim of a context-free 12-dimensional Markov sufficient state.
Source disjointness covers the complete recorded V2/V3/V4 identities, not unknown pretraining or writers.
The fixed V3 Q_ref targets refer to the frozen reference continuation, not the eventual adaptive policy or an optimal value function.
Final/runtime/production and original substantive B03-B07 claims remain unestablished without their own evidence.

failure_policy.failed_formal_comparison: Terminal failure for this candidate qualification; retain each result and do not open final or new runtime holdout.
failure_policy.infrastructure_failure: Record exact progress and partial evidence; do not silently rerun a consumed outcome or discard failed paths. Any recovery requires an independently audited, prospectively documented state-identical continuation.
failure_policy.negative_evidence_scope: Failure to pass is lack of established gain under this contract, not an automatic refutation of the parameter-field theory.

numerics_and_resources.accounting: All attempted/rejected/zero blocks, gradient and directional work, generator/teacher/observer work, complete optimizer transactions, calibration and policy CPU/wall, storage and verification costs are retained. Logical work is not FLOP or wall-time equivalence.
numerics_and_resources.endpoint_output_storage: Lossless uint8 generated pixels, exact UTF-8 captions, output hashes, source IDs and both observer utility arrays for all paths and original baselines; no mean-only replacement.

panel_origin.context_scope: Readonly per seed/panel/path calibration in addition to the 12-dimensional readout; not a claim of an unconditioned 12-dimensional Markov sufficient state.
panel_origin.formula: x_prime[I] = x[I] - (observed_initial[I] - frozen_fit_initial[I]); x_prime[not I] = x[not I]
panel_origin.frozen_fit_initial: Each seed BANK.json step-zero states; all four trajectories must match exactly on I. No averaging or new-panel fitting.
panel_origin.name: initial_panel_translation_H12
panel_origin.observed_initial: Exactly one pre-update measurement from the new phase authorized probe/guard inputs. Reuse the already scheduled step-zero raw measurement when possible. Never use qualification endpoint task/clean outcomes.
panel_origin.storage_accounting: 112 bytes is the active 14-coordinate float64 calibration array only. Full raw30/fit30 audit metadata, repeated journals, Python containers, temporary vectors and frozen heads are separately retained and measured; 112 bytes is not total memory or storage.
unchanged: learning rate, momentum, clipping, rehearsal and teacher anchor
raw clean guard, full optimizer rollback and zero-action accounting
fixed training deployment action and hard scoring

order: register code, sources, protocol and all old controller inputs
train all 108 paths without task/clean endpoint tensors or audit observer
freeze all 108 checkpoints and complete trace inventories
independent seal validation and external endpoint freeze
evaluate all 108 retained paths plus three original-model baselines

qualification.adaptive_selection_source: Released V3 richer30 selection, given the same legal initial-panel calibration information; no V4 reselection.
qualification.clean_rule: All three corrected interval lower bounds strictly above -0.01 under both observers.
qualification.gain_rule: All three corrected interval lower bounds strictly above zero, and each of the three fixed model means strictly positive, under both observers.

method_semantics.origin_generic: frozen generic12 on the same translated states
method_semantics.origin_h7: frozen H7 on the same translated states
method_semantics.origin_richer: frozen richer30 on the same translated states
method_semantics.raw_field: unchanged V3 H12 on raw states

qualification.ordinary_selection_source: Released V3 selection fixed before any V4 model outcomes; these are gradient multiplier indices, not deployment actions.
qualification.passed_means: Eligible to prepare a separately registered independent final. Does not establish runtime, Hepta-specific representation, two-layer synergy, LLM-scale or production claims.
qualification.quantile: numpy.quantile(method=linear); equal-tail two-sided interval, alpha/6 per observer
qualification.resampling: Each of 4000 draws: sample 4 paired rollout IDs independently within each fixed model, shared across methods/observers/task-clean; one shared task source-pair draw across all methods/models/conditions, then a separate shared clean source-pair draw. Equal fixed-model and condition weights. Models are not resampled.

registration_rule: Execution requires an external source freeze binding this exact protocol and its executable dependency closure to a published Git commit before the first new-model call. This file alone is not an execution receipt.

runtime_boundary.reason: All six fixed stage-split pilot comparisons were negative on released development data; no new runtime experiment is registered by this protocol.

training.fit_ridge_selection: whole-trajectory leave-one-out prediction MSE, fit-only normalization, listed-alpha tie break
training.fixed_actions_source: V2 frozen PILOT_SUMMARY.json original-model winners; no V3 outcome selection
training.guard_failure: restore full parameter and SGD state; advance schedule clock; charge all work
training.value_target: Q_ref terminal hard utility after candidate48-step block followed by frozen reference policy to288; not optimal Q or deployed-policy value
training.zero_action: compute and charge gradients; do not step or modify parameters/momentum
